name: spotlight-testimonial

frames.best_why: The first quote is settled with its italic highlight, portrait, author details and dot controls all visible.

tagline: One big customer quote at a time, fading to the next every few seconds.
summary: A wide pale section with a heading, then a single oversized testimonial under a round quote mark. The quote fades to the next automatically, each with a portrait, name and role, and three dots below switch between them.
appearance: Off-white page with a centred black heading and a grey two-line intro. Below sits a pale circular quote-mark medallion, three lines of large dark quote text with one phrase in grey italics, a small round portrait, an uppercase name, a grey role and three small dots where the active one stretches into a short dark bar.
behaviour: Every three seconds the current quote and author fade away and the next pair rises in. Clicking a dot jumps straight to that quote and widens the chosen dot while the others stay small.
demo_content: Heading "Success Stories" with quotes from James Clear, Sarah Chen and Marcus Williams.
search_phrases: single quote carousel for landing page
customer praise with photo and role
quotes that fade every few seconds
social proof one quote at a time
use_when: A landing page wants one large rotating testimonial with minimal chrome and obvious dot controls.
avoid_when: Only three quotes are fixed, and autoplay runs every three seconds with no pause or reduced-motion respect.
customise: The three quotes, highlighted phrases, names, roles and photos are a hardcoded array; the three-second interval and greys need source edits.
weight_why: Only one quote is on screen at a time; a small fade runs every three seconds.

a11y.note: Dots are labelled buttons and can be tabbed to, but the three-second autoplay has no pause and ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: The quote area is blank until the entrance animation runs, leaving a large empty section.
Autoplay advances every three seconds with no way to pause it.
polish_why: Clean airy layout and a smooth quote fade; the grey highlight is faint and frame 1 is empty.
title: Spotlight Testimonial
